title: docs(skills): teach dataset member synonyms and description (ADR-0149 D1)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbSX2kCrNTernUTFw5Eb1RBb)_

Fixes #31659

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：已发布技能里的数据集示例现在会写维度/指标的业务同义词（`synonyms`）和业务定义（`description`），i18n 技能写明了它们的翻译键位置，并说明同义词不翻译。
- 为什么改：PR #31652 已让 spec 接受这两个键，但技能没教，AI 写数据集时就不会写，数据集问答的准确度提升就无从谈起。
- 风险与回滚：只改技能文档和一个 changeset，不碰运行时；新增字数在同一文件里删掉重复句子抵掉，词元上限不变。回滚即撤销本 PR。
- 先看：`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md` 的 `defineDataset` 示例及其下方四行注释（新规则），然后 `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` 的 `datasets` 一句。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:skill-examples`，预期 332 个示例全部通过类型检查（含带 `synonyms` 的新示例）。
- 需要你做的：本 PR 改 `skills/**`，属 Tier H，请由 GOVERNED_APPROVERS 账户给出 APPROVED 评审（契约评审由席位安排）。

## What changes

Teaches the ADR-0149 D1 member vocabulary from the merged spec (`packages/spec/src/ui/dataset.zod.ts`, `packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts` at 907fdca903):

- `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md` (Server-side date bucketing, the `os:check` `defineDataset` block): the measure now carries `synonyms: ['签约数', 'deals signed']` and a one-sentence `description`; a four-line comment states the rules the schema enforces: synonyms are the words a question uses, every language in one list, matched and never translated, never equal to another member's name, label or synonym (`checkDatasetVocabulary`); `description` is a business definition, never a prompt, translated like `label` (`datasetMemberDescription`).
- `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` (top-level groups paragraph): `datasets` holds `label` + `description` per dataset and per member at `datasets.{dataset}.{dimensions,measures}.{member}`; member `synonyms` have no key (`DATASET_MEMBER_SYNONYMS_NOT_TRANSLATED`).
- The retired-rule sweep found nothing to remove: `grep -rn 'guidance' skills/` has no `guidance.description` hit, and no skill page says a measure or dimension has no `description`.
- `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md` is unchanged: its Analytics dataset row links to `rules/dashboards.md`, and the file sits at 0 tokens of headroom.

Token payment (ceilings unchanged, `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`):

- `dashboards.md`: 6231 -> 6232 of 6232. Paid by deleting five restatements whose rule survives in the same file: the intro's "selects named dimensions + values" (survives in Dataset-Bound Widgets), the KPI example's `dateGranularity` comment (survives in Server-side date bucketing), the `DatasetSelection.compareTo` gloss (the key table states the shape), "Authors do not format dimension/measure values by hand" (survives in "Human labels are automatic"), and the report comment's "binds a dataset and selects rows + values BY NAME" (survives in Dataset-Bound Widgets and the `rows` note).
- `objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md`: 5719 -> 5763 of 6333 (headroom 570).

Line readings: `dashboards.md` 473 -> 474, `objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` 522 -> 524; all `skills/*/SKILL.md` summed 4592 -> 4594. Bundle tokens 239600 -> 239645.

## Tests

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:skill-examples`: exit 0, 332 blocks across 3 surfaces.
- Reverse check: `synonyms: 'deals signed'` planted in the marked block -> exit 1 at `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md:296:58` (TS2322 `string` not assignable to `string[]`); restored with `git checkout HEAD --`, `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Acceptance notes

- The build runs on the default tier under the no-Fable-build exit; `dispatch-gates --tier` mandates Fable for `skills/**`. The contract review is the seat's.

## Verification

Derived gate sweep (`dispatch-gates --commands`, 46 commands) on 442b316b: 45 exit 0, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3 (needs a full build; NOT MEASURED, CI runs it); `--ran` reconciles 46 of 46. The merge of `main` (4b813c70) touched no `skills/**` file; the token ratchet and `check:skill-examples` re-ran green there. Full readings in the os-dev-report on #31659.
